summary.text: OPPLYSNINGEN 1881 AS is a private limited company registered in Lysaker, founded 2010-09-03. Its registered activity: "Tilby informasjonstjenester samt virksomhet som står i tilknytning til dette, herunder opprettelse av datterselskaper og aksjeeier i andre selskaper." Its main industry code is 82.200: activities of call centres. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 158 780 254 NOK and the annual result was 42 899 192 NOK; operating income was up from 158 020 443 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 36 847 573 NOK in 2024 to 42 899 192 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 130 180 846 NOK in 2024 to 122 592 824 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 59 on 2025-11-13 to 55 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
